sources.snippet: We construct BDD100K, the largest open driving video dataset with 100K videos and 10 tasks to evaluate the exciting progress of image recognition algorithms on autonomous driving. Each video has 40 seconds and a high resolution. The dataset represents more than 1000 hours of driving experience with more than 100 million frames.

sources.title: Bdd100k Dataset by Ultralytics
sources.snippet: BDD100K Images 100K is UC Berkeley's diverse driving benchmark, sampled from video across varied geography, weather, lighting, and road conditions. Ten detection classes cover vehicles, riders, pedestrians, traffic lights, and traffic signs in complex street scenes.
